workflow.name: EEVL Content Pipeline
workflow.description: End-to-end content pipeline for Eagle Eye Vision Labz (EEVL). Driven by SocialBot sub-agent. Covers idea harvesting, content creation, design asset generation, and multi-platform distribution.

tasks.name: Idea Harvest
tasks.description: Scrape trending content from TikTok and Reddit, analyze competitors, score trends, and populate the content calendar.

tasks.name: Content Creation
tasks.description: Draft blog posts, social captions, hashtags, SEO copy, email newsletters, and video script outlines using EEVL brand voice.

tasks.name: Design Assets
tasks.description: Generate platform-specific graphics, carousels, and thumbnails using the EEVL brand kit via Canva API.

tasks.name: Multi-Platform Distribution
tasks.description: Publish content and assets across all social platforms, send email newsletters, monitor engagement, and run A/B tests.

scheduled.description: Daily content pipeline run at 6:00 AM UTC for social posting and engagement checks.
Weekly deep harvest every Monday at 9:00 AM UTC for trend analysis and content calendar planning.

manual.description: Trigger the pipeline on-demand for campaign launches, urgent posts, or ad-hoc content needs.

web_scrape.name: Web Scrape MCP
web_scrape.description: General-purpose web scraping for competitor analysis, blog research, and page content extraction.

apify.name: Apify MCP
apify.description: TikTok trending content scraping, Reddit thread mining, and structured data extraction at scale.

openrouter.name: OpenRouter MCP
openrouter.description: LLM routing to GPT-4o for content drafting, caption generation, SEO optimization, and copywriting.

canva_api.name: Canva API MCP
canva_api.description: Programmatic design generation using EEVL brand kit — social graphics, carousels, thumbnails, and stories.

social_platforms.name: Social Platforms MCP
social_platforms.description: Publishing, scheduling, and engagement monitoring across all connected social media accounts.
